object.description: Setup: with month selected, current-month workouts of 5.00 km in 25:00, 1.00 km in 10:00 and 12.00 km in 55:00; a 20.00 km workout in an earlier month. Steps: 1. Open the Stats screen. 2. Read total distance, average pace, longest distance, number of workouts, total duration, total calories and peak pace. Expected: Total distance 18.00 km; average pace 5:00 per km (5400 s / 18 km); longest distance 12.00 km; 3 workouts; total duration 1:30:00; total calories equal to the sum of the three workouts; peak pace equal to the shortest of the three workouts' peak paces; the earlier-month workout excluded from every figure.
